title: FairUDT: Fairness-aware Uplift Decision Trees
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Religion is mentioned only as a hypothetical example of a protected attribute in the introduction, but it is not included as a variable in any of the datasets, experiments, or analysis.

measurement_description: The paper mentions religion as a potential protected attribute against which bias can occur, but none of the benchmarks or experiments actually measure anything related to faith or religion. The sensitive attributes used in the experiments were gender, race, and age.
